Ningxia Orient Tantalum.why: Makes capacitor-grade tantalum powder and tantalum wire, which the company says are among the main raw materials for tantalum capacitors (passive components on AI server boards)
Ningxia Orient Tantalum.evidence: Ningxia Orient Tantalum investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-16-2026): the company said its capacitor-grade tantalum powder and tantalum wire are among the main raw materials for making tantalum capacitors

players.product: Capacitor-grade tantalum powder and tantalum wire (main raw materials for tantalum capacitors); also high-purity tantalum powder, tantalum ingots and 12-inch tantalum target blanks

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum IR activity record: 2026-022 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, site visit): H1 2026 revenue growth came mainly from gradual capacity release, higher tantalum and niobium product sales volumes and gradually higher tantalum product prices; facing sharply higher tantalum-niobium raw-material prices, the company kept passing costs through, with product pricing linked to raw-material prices, while keeping long-term relationships with core customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum IR activity record: 2026-022 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): in 2026 the company launched a new round of fundraising projects worth RMB 11.89 hundred million. The tantalum-niobium hydrometallurgy digital factory has finished civil works and the whole project is in equipment installation and commissioning; on the pyrometallurgy smelting line expansion retrofit the main equipment is progressively entering commissioning and trial production; on the high-end products line the main equipment is being installed and commissioned. Management said once in production the three projects will relieve capacity bottlenecks and make key raw materials self-controlled.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum IR activity record: 2026-022 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, market view): driven by explosive growth in AI and computing-power chips, demand for advanced-node chips has surged, markedly lifting demand for semiconductor tantalum sputtering targets and high-purity tantalum ingots; the company's high-purity tantalum powder, high-purity tantalum ingots and 12-inch tantalum target blanks have achieved full-process technical breakthroughs and industrial integration. In superalloys, demand from gas turbines, aerospace engines and turbochargers has grown and the company's superalloy products grew noticeably as retrofit capacity was released. In capacitors, tantalum capacitor demand is recovering with the consumer electronics recovery.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum IR activity record: 2026-022 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): raw-material supply - the company has a global tantalum-niobium concentrate procurement system built on long-term relationships with large ore traders. China Nonferrous Metal Mining Group's subsidiary China Nonferrous Metals Trade (under the company's actual controller) completed the acquisition of Brazilian ore producer Taboca Mining, and in 2026 the company again signed a ferro-tantalum-niobium alloy purchase contract with Taboca; the company also recycles tantalum-niobium scrap across its hydrometallurgy, pyrometallurgy, tantalum powder, tantalum wire and products plants and buys scrap externally.
